name: segnale-remoto
description: Survival/crafting co-op 3D low-poly per 2-4 amici, da browser e PC.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @segnale/server" "npm run dev -w @segnale/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @segnale/client && npm run build -w @segnale/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
